visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and a white cardigan stands in front of a dark backdrop with decorative wall art. She holds a smartphone with a character-patterned case, gesturing with her right hand as she speaks directly into the camera lens with an expressive, friendly face. (2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit office setting filled with computer monitors, cluttered desks, and ergonomic chairs. A woman with a short black bob and a black jacket is seated at a desk, looking surprised or inquisitive while holding a yellow object. (3) A close-up shot follows, focusing on a smartphone screen displaying the LINE messaging app. A person with manicured nails and rings demonstrates a drag-and-drop feature, selecting multiple chat bubbles containing drink orders and grouping them together on the screen interface. (4) The hands on the screen drag the grouped messages across various apps, including the Notes app and Instagram, showcasing the cross-app functionality. The woman with short hair reappears, reacting with wide-eyed shock and a hand over her mouth while holding a maroon smartphone in a selfie pose. (5) The video concludes with the first woman standing in a modern office hallway with white walls and exposed ceiling pipes. She has a slightly annoyed or bored expression, holding her phone and looking away from the camera as the scene fades.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is an instructional tech tip designed to teach users a hidden productivity feature on iPhone for the LINE app. By using a relatable scenario of ordering group drinks and a comedic interaction between two characters, it educates viewers on how to drag and drop multiple messages efficiently across different applications.
